content.title: Company Overview
content.content:
SnapLogic is an enterprise software company headquartered in San Mateo, California, USA. The company was founded in 2006 by Gaurav Dhillon, who previously co-founded and led Informatica Corporation — one of the defining enterprise data integration companies of its era. SnapLogic was founded with a specific mandate: to build the next generation of data integration and automation software for the API economy and modern cloud era, combining ETL with a modern, cloud-native, low-code architecture.

- **Headquarters**: San Mateo, California, USA

- **Global offices**: London (UK), Amsterdam (Netherlands), Munich (Germany), Hyderabad (India), Melbourne (Australia), New York (USA)

- **Employees**: ~600 globally, including pre-sales, engineering, customer success, and support teams with presence across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions

- **Ownership**: Privately held. Principal investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Salesforce Ventures, Capital One Ventures

- **Customer base**: 600+ enterprise customers including Global 2000 companies across financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and aerospace supply chains

- **Analyst recognition**: Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS: 11 consecutive years recognized (last 5 years as Leader or Visionary in iPaaS); Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools (7 years); Forrester Wave for iPaaS: Named a Leader (Q3 2025)

- **Business value**: Former Total Economic Impact study (2020): 181% ROI over 3 years, payback period under 6 months, $1.7M in efficiency gains, $1.4M in technology savings per representative customer
